subject: Azure connector bundle — pricing, discounting, and partner netting
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@datasail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tbenson@datasail.com>, procurement@datasail.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Azure connector bundle — initial pricing ask

Jordan — thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here — Tom and I are pulling together internal approval for the enterprise connector bundle (Azure private offer + 500k node-hours reserved annually). Two quick asks so we can move to legal: 1) target net cost to our rev team after reseller/pass-through (we need to show 10% partner margin in our ledger), and 2) a 1- and 3-year committed price schedule (list price, Redwood discount, and final net to DataSail).

We'd also like clarity on invoice path: will we be invoiced directly by Redwood or via our reseller partner (Northgate Solutions)? If via reseller, we need the reseller split and any holdback mechanics documented. Attaching our standard procurement template separately.

Thanks — can you get a preliminary workbook by EOD Tue (our internal approval meeting is Wed)?

— Anika
Head of Procurement
DataSail Inc.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@datasail.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure connector bundle — initial pricing ask

Anika — appreciate the clear asks. I'll get you a short workbook tonight with line items and two commitment profiles. Quick clarifications so the workbook matches your approval packet: 1) When you say "10% partner margin in our ledger" — is that a firm requirement (i.e., Northgate requires 10% net) or an accounting presentation target? 2) Can you confirm whether DataSail wants Redwood to list a private offer in the Azure Marketplace or if you'd prefer a consolidated invoice routed through Northgate (we can support both, but the pass-through mechanics differ).

Connor and Naomi — looped you in for channel margin guidance and to confirm invoice-path ops. Connor — can you prepare a recommended reseller split and holdback options (two variants: reseller-billed vs Redwood-billed with reseller crediting)? Naomi — please prep expected tax/treatments for a US-based reseller flow.

I'll send the workbook by 6pm PST.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure connector bundle — internal margin recommendation

Jordan — draft guidance below; I built two scenarios so we can present a choice to DataSail. I'll attach a quick CSV to drop into the workbook.

Scenario A (Redwood invoices DataSail; reseller gets credit):
- List price (Azure PO): $1,200,000/yr (500k node-hours)
- Redwood suggested discount: 12% -> effective Redwood price $1,056,000
- Reseller pass-through (Northgate) credit: 10% of list ($120,000) credited to DataSail on invoice or via separate credit memo.
- Net to DataSail after reseller credit: $936,000
- Netback to reseller (reported as partner margin): 10% target met by crediting mechanism.
- Holdback: Optional 5% retainage on year-one until activation milestones (we can structure a repayment schedule).

Scenario B (Northgate invoices; Redwood offers deeper discount to reseller):
- List price (Azure PO): $1,200,000/yr
- Redwood discount to reseller: 18% -> reseller pays $984,000 upfront (Northgate invoiced)
- Northgate resells to DataSail at a markup; to show 10% partner margin, Northgate's final bill to DataSail would be $1,082,400 (reseller keeps $98,400).
- Net to DataSail: Depends on how Northgate structures the invoice; for simplicity we can provide an example invoice path.

Trade-offs: Scenario A keeps AR with Redwood (simpler for us) and gives DataSail a transparent credit. Scenario B shifts AR to the reseller but requires a reseller-side marketplace private offer flow and likely a reseller agreement amendment.

I'll add recommended language for holdbacks and a simple refund schedule. I suggest offering Scenario A as default and Scenario B as an option if procurement insists on reseller-billed invoices.

Connor
Director, Deal Ops
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@datasail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tbenson@datasail.com>, procurement@datasail.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure connector bundle — pricing, discounting, and partner netting

Jordan / Connor — thanks, that helps. DataSail prefers reseller invoicing through Northgate for procurement reasons (audit trail and single vendor). That pushes us toward Scenario B, but we need two small changes to present to legal: 1) a guaranteed reseller net guarantee (Northgate must be able to show 10% margin to the auditors) and 2) a clear clause showing whether Redwood will support remediation credits if Northgate overcharges.

Also: can you confirm whether private offer SKUs will be visible in the partner's invoicing (we need line-level detail for node-hour consumption for chargeback to internal cost centers).

If you can update the workbook with Scenario B numbers and a suggested contractual clause for reseller net guarantee + remediation credit, we can start legal review.

— Anika
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@datasail.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure connector bundle — pricing, discounting, and partner netting

Anika — understood. Updated workbook attached ("datasail-pricing-workbook.xlsx"). Key updates:
- Scenario B example invoice attached: shows line-level node-hour usage per SKU and an explicit reseller margin line (Northgate margin = 10% of list by default).
- Contract language (draft clause): "Reseller Net Guarantee: Redwood and Northgate agree that, for the duration of the Term, the reseller margin applicable to the Reseller Invoice will be no less than 10% of the published List Price for the Azure Connector SKUs. Should the reseller invoice result in a smaller net margin to Reseller, Redwood agrees to provide remediation credit(s) to DataSail or Reseller as documented in a remediation schedule."
- Remediation mechanics: credit memo generation window (30 days), and a quarterly reconciliation cadence.

We can support Northgate to produce a reseller-billed private offer. Naomi — tax guidance attached in the workbook. Connor — I left optional holdback language (5% activation milestone) as a negotiable item.

Next steps: 1) Anika — confirm Northgate is confirmed as your reseller and provide reseller contract contact; 2) If DataSail wants, I can set up a short call (30m) with Northgate and our Deal Ops to walk through invoicing and the private offer flow.

I'll also share a DocuSign link once legal confirms the clause.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Tom Benson <tbenson@datasail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@datasail.com>
Cc: procurement@datasail.com, Northgate Sales <contracts@northgate.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure connector bundle — pricing, discounting, and partner netting

Jordan / team — Northgate confirmed as our reseller; I looped their contract contact in. We reviewed the workbook and Scenario B looks workable. Two action items from our side: 1) Northgate will send a proposed reseller order routing and sample invoice by EOD Fri; 2) Procurement requests the remediation clause be limited to 12 months post-invoice (we'll propose this in our redline).

We attached a short procurement checklist to our side — please confirm if Redwood requires a separate reseller addendum or if the private offer + reseller invoice path is sufficient for your ops. We'll wait for your DocuSign link to proceed with legal.

Regards,
Tom Benson
VP, IT Sourcing
DataSail Inc.
